result_text:
I changed the `all_files.zip` export in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java` so it no longer uses hardcoded file names. The `reports` module compiles. I did not run any tests and did not try a renamed aspect end to end.

It now takes the five scope aspects (main, test, generated, build and deployment, other) in that order. For each one it gets the file name from `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, which is the same method that writes the loose `aspect_<name>.txt` files. It then reads that file and adds it to the zip under the same name.

With the default config the entries stay `aspect_main.txt`, `aspect_test.txt`, `aspect_generated.txt`, `aspect_build_and_deployment.txt` and `aspect_other.txt`. With the renamed aspect, the fourth entry becomes `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`. Because the read no longer fails, the `git-history.zip` step after it should now run too when a `git-history.txt` exists.

I left `LandscapeAnalyzer.java` alone. It also reads `aspect_main.txt` and `aspect_build_and_deployment.txt` by fixed name, but that is outside this export.
